title: Stagewise Adaptive Boosting
abstract: arXiv:2611.18662v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Stagewise algorithms and sparsity-inducing regularization are two influential approaches to high-dimensional modeling. Existing stagewise theory, however, largely centers on convex regularization, whereas stronger sparsity and other structural preferences are often pursued through fixed-level nonconvex optimization rather than generating an entire adaptive solution path. We develop stagewise adaptive boosting, a general framework that builds a monotone path by selecting the update consistent with structural preference. The framework can encourage sparsity along the path itself and also admits extensions that promote other properties of the solution, including group selection, similarity across models for multiple outcomes, and known priorities or prerequisite relations among predictors. translated_title: 分阶段自适应提升算法
translated_abstract: 分阶段算法和诱导稀疏性的正则化是高维建模中两种有影响力的方法。然而，现有的分阶段理论主要集中于凸正则化，而更强的稀疏性以及其他结构偏好通常通过固定水平的非凸优化来追求，而非生成一条完整的自适应解路径。我们提出了分阶段自适应提升，这是一个通用框架，通过选择与结构偏好一致的更新来构建单调路径。该框架能够在路径本身上促进稀疏性，同时还允许进行扩展以促进解的其他性质，包括组选择、多个结果模型之间的相似性，以及预测变量之间已知的优先级或先决关系。我们研究了其理论性质，并通过模拟和真实数据分析研究了其有限样本性能。在这些研究中，所提出的路径（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出分阶段自适应提升这一通用框架，通过沿单调路径选择符合结构偏好的更新来促进稀疏性等解的性质，并可扩展至组选择、多结果模型相似性以及预测变量优先关系等场景。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes stagewise adaptive boosting, a general framework that builds a monotone solution path by selecting updates consistent with structural preferences, promoting sparsity along the path and extending to group selection, cross-model similarity, and predictor priority relations.
